Description:
What motivates you? Is it power? Money? Respect? Or perhaps an insatiable craving for more, an unquenchable thirst that drives you relentlessly forward? Your race has built towering empires, conquered nations, and endured catastrophic collapses. Humans, embodying the duality of their nature, have proven themselves to be both the paragons of leadership and the epitomes of tyranny.
For every human, there exists an inherent aspiration for more. They yearn to leave the familiar confines of their towns and embark on grand adventures, driven by a potent mixture of thrill-seeking and the allure of promised rewards. No mountain stands too tall, no ocean runs too deep, and no desert presents an insurmountable challenge to these innate explorers. Humans possess an innate ability to multitask, deftly juggling myriad responsibilities, and they possess a sharp acumen for swiftly and efficiently solving problems.
The origin of the humans remains shrouded in mystery. Among the younger races, they burst forth seemingly out of nowhere, establishing themselves as a force to be reckoned with. Humans make formidable allies when befriended, their adaptability and resourcefulness shining through. However, one must exercise caution, for their unpredictable nature can transform them into formidable adversaries when antagonized. The humans, a complex and ever-evolving race, carry within them the potential for greatness or darkness, and their story continues to unfold across the realms, leaving an indelible mark wherever they tread.
Language: You speak Common and a number of chosen languages equal to your Intelligence or Presence (whichever is higher).

~Jack of all Trades~.Effect: You gain +1 in your lowest Stat and +2 Skill Points.

Starting Abilities Description.Humans: Humans are among the most consistent of the races and their concentration and mental resilience make them able to constantly succeed at menial tasks.

Starting Abilities Description.Human Diversity: There are several interesting starting Abilities you can choose from as a Human! Wow!

Starting Abilities Description.Talented:
Humans start with Training in any 2 Weapon Categories (1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Melee, 1-Handed Ranged, 2-Handed Ranged and Shields).
Check the Weapons page to see all the weapon categories!

Combat Extras: You swim at normal Movement Speed
~Tideborn~.Effect:
You can swim at your normal Movement Speed.
You have +1 in Swimming, Boating and Fishing.

~Blue Blood~.Effect: You can choose +1 Minor or Utility Talent.

~Hunter-Gatherer~.Effect:
Whenever you and your party defeats a boss, gain +1 non-Combat Skill Point.
You have +1 in Harvesting.

~Pigmy~.Effect:
Distract an enemy so that it won't attack you with its next attack.
At the end of this Combat, you gain +10% of all the {Gold}Gold your party looted from this encounter (rounded down).

~Spiritually Aligned~.Effect: You are immune to being Silenced and Cursed, and have +2 in Mental Resilience.

~Fated~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, a random Enemy gets a ~Combo~.
You have +2 in Luck.

~Genes of Olden Roots~.Effect: You gain +2 Initiative and you are immune to Exhaustion from lack of sleep.

~Diversity and Inclusion~.Effect: You get -2 Max Health. Choose a Race Talent from any other Race.

Combat Extras: When rolling Event, something good or bad might happen
~Augmented~.Effect:
You have +2 Max Health and +1 Health Regen, but -1 Presence.
When rolling an Event (two equal numbers on the 2d6), something slightly good or bad might happen to your body. The higher the roll, the better.

~Human Vigilence~.Effect: Whenever you make a Check (before the roll), instead of rolling, you can automatically take the number 6 for the die (as if you rolled 6) for that Check.

~Ignorance Bliss~.Effect: In Abilities that use Presence, Intelligence or Presence, you can use the number 3 instead.
~Ignorance Bliss~.Notes: E.g. Chilling Shout becomes 15 (12 + 3) instead of 12 + ^Presence^. Phase Orb becomes 2d6 + 3 + 3 instead of 2d6 + ^Intelligence + Presence^.
